purpose: Feedback-conditioned development controls and independent-holdout admission audit
rules_baseline: Feedback-aware deterministic frequency-first rule workflow; not the original unconditional production rules graph
single_router: One routing call may select the same feedback-aware rule workflow; no deliberately weak single-call baseline
data_policy: Paired cases share waveform bytes; all belong to the same analytic AM family, not independent physical entities

cases.description: First run basic analysis and calculate ideal bearing frequencies BEFORE envelope analysis. Read the actual frequency result: if it reports missing uncertainty (such as geometry_uncertainty), stop with the available basic/frequency observations. Only if uncertainty is complete continue with unbound envelope, context-bound envelope and frequency matching. Preserve diagnostic qualification limits.
